decision.reason: [ev-e54c7ef2acc9] says support for the `1.20` `compatibilityProfile` was removed, but it never says where that profile is set: no Helm values path, env var or flag. The proposed leaf `ISTIO_COMPATIBILITY_PROFILE` env var does not appear anywhere in the evidence, so that identifier is made up. The note calls ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING and VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT "flags" and says they were removed. It does not say they are istiod environment variables, and none of the surrounding installation-section items [ev-c6870d2efa84, ev-28f7b790cdd3] name the configuration key either. To decide this, I would need upstream text (an upgrade guide, chart values or code) showing the exact key or variable that selects the compatibility profile, and where these flags are read.
